decisions.reason: The same-message INTRODUCE already records email-link dashboard access and SIWE through the Transak-created wallet, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Adding SIWE through the Transak-created wallet provides an alternative access path but does not remove or alter the existing email-link authentication method.
Wallet-based dashboard sign-in does not change the requirement that public data APIs remain unauthenticated.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already states that fiat buyers may access the dashboard through the email link or SIWE using the Transak-created wallet.
The wallet-authentication decision does not necessarily change the About page content; the message-184 About-page update concerns prize delivery instead.
The ebook viewer behavior is established by a separate clause in the source message and is unaffected by the Transak-wallet SIWE access decision.
The certificate already includes the dashboard link, while the added SIWE option changes dashboard authentication rather than certificate contents or delivery.
Allowing SIWE with a Transak-created wallet does not change the Brevo transport provider or email-delivery behavior.
Winner notification channels are addressed by an independent clause in message 184 and are not changed by the wallet-authentication decision.
The dashboard authentication path does not alter the mint-number referral-code identity or its display surfaces.
Automatic prize transfer is established by a separate clause and is unaffected by whether a fiat buyer enters the dashboard through an email link or SIWE.
The Transak-wallet SIWE access decision does not change the Small Block prize amount, cadence, eligibility, funding, or ticket-reset rules.
